title: The Last Ember Anew
author: Hazel Sandoval
blurb: Jude Ashgrove, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
